audit.why: Zyra is immobile and squishy before her plants stack, so levels 1-2 favor Renata's Handshake all-in; from level 3 her Deadly Spines (Q) and Grasping Roots (E) plant-poke out-range Renata's kit through late game and into teamfights.

Renata's spike is the level 1-2 all-in window before Zyra's plants come online; Zyra spikes from level 3 onward and again at level 6 when Stranglethorns (R, 110/100/90s CD) buffs her plants and knocks up.
